brief:
Nearly 80 percent of Britons see Israel as a threat to world peace, according to Middle East Eye. The sharp shift in public opinion follows Israel's military operations in Gaza and the war on Iran, which have reshaped attitudes among British voters toward the country.

The polling reflects broader changes in how Britons perceive Israel's role in regional and global stability.

title: Most Britons now view Israel as threat to peace
